mostWorthwhile.text: The collecting-duct construction was most worthwhile: its planned picture connects ADH receptors and added water channels to the concentration difference that draws water back toward blood.

leastWorthwhile.text: Connecting the separately assembled hormone route to the body was straightforward but repeated the pathway already shown, so it added relatively little.

surprise.text: The final picture shows fewer ADH signals as plasma approaches its usual concentration, extending the earlier water-saving sequence into a feedback response.

arbitrary.text: Building the posterior-pituitary nerve endings and blood vessels as a separate object after ADH had already been released felt somewhat artificial, although its purpose was clear.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: the constructions connect familiar diffusion concepts to whole-body regulation, although I would welcome a plain-language expansion of ADH and a clearer explanation of the feedback loop. These are judgments of the supplied illustration plans, not evidence of student understanding.
